label: Blood pressure
rationale: Check at least yearly, and more often if readings run high or you have risk factors.

label: Lipid panel
rationale: Repeat roughly every 5 years when results are normal; sooner with a family history of high cholesterol.

label: Blood sugar (glucose / HbA1c)
rationale: Recheck every few years; sooner with excess weight or a family history of diabetes.

label: HIV test
rationale: One-time baseline test in adulthood, then repeat only if your risk changes.

label: Hepatitis C test
rationale: One-time test in adulthood, since infection is often silent.

label: Hepatitis B status and vaccination
rationale: Check immunity or infection status once, and vaccinate if you are not protected.

label: General check-up
rationale: Yearly visit with a primary-care doctor.

label: Testicular self-check
rationale: Check regularly; testicular cancer is most common in younger men.

label: Skin self-check
rationale: Look over your skin regularly and note any change in moles.

label: Mood and anxiety questionnaire
rationale: Fill in a short PHQ-9 / GAD-7 questionnaire from time to time.

label: Hearing test
rationale: Every 2 years if you have had loud-noise or blast exposure.

label: Colonoscopy
rationale: Screening starts at 45, or earlier with a family history of colorectal cancer.

label: PSA (prostate) discussion
rationale: Talk to a doctor about PSA testing from 50, or earlier with a family history of prostate cancer.
